nodes.label: Stealth Browser Scraping Pattern
nodes.rationale: Uses playwright-extra with StealthPlugin and a realistic user-agent + Dutch locale to avoid bot detection on supermarket websites.

nodes.label: Smart Discount Deduplication Logic
nodes.rationale: addDiscountSmart skips insertion if an active non-expired discount already exists for the product, avoiding duplicate records while supporting historic table growth across promotion periods.

nodes.label: Promotion-Aware Scheduling Pattern
nodes.rationale: Next scraper run is calculated as midnight the day AFTER the promotion expire date, so the scraper catches new promotions as soon as they go live.
